# The Nexus — Office Space & Cowork Facility

> The Nexus is a calm, serene office space rental and cowork property located between Adoor and Kottarakkara in Pathanamthitta District (bordering Kollam District), Keralam, India. Designed specifically for small IT firms, freelancers, tech consultants, and video editors.

## Quick Facts
- **Property Name**: The Nexus
- **Primary Contact Phone**: +91 9972166327 (Direct Call & Inquiries)
- **Administrative District**: Situated in Pathanamthitta District, immediately adjacent to Kollam District, Kerala, India
- **Town Proximity**: Positioned along the corridor between Adoor Town (~8-10 mins) and Kottarakkara Town (~10-12 mins)
- **Geo Coordinates**: 9.087981, 76.764186
- **Primary Domain & Canonical URL**: https://thenexus.niyogilabs.com/
- **Visual Disclaimer**: Website imagery consists of hand-drawn architectural concept sketches without annotations representing the property developer's vision for the property, and are not actual photographs.

## Strategic Connectivity & Transit
- **Trivandrum International Airport (TRV)**: ~1.5 hours drive (~85 km)
- **Cochin International Airport (COK)**: ~4 hours drive (~155 km)
- **Interstate Access**: Road access to Tamil Nadu state border is just 40 km away (Shenkottai / Tenkasi highway corridor)
- **Beaches & Hill Stations**: Popular Kerala beaches (Varkala, Kollam) and Western Ghats hill stations (Thenmala, Ponmudi, Vagamon) all within a 40 km to 150 km drive

## Target Audience & Ideal Customers
- **Small IT Firms & Software Teams**: Managed office floor space and desk bays with reliable fiber connectivity and continuous power.
- **Freelancers & Remote Engineers**: Quiet, high-focus work environment free from city noise.
- **Tech Consultants**: Executive meeting room equipped with 4K displays and video conferencing capabilities.
- **Video Editors & Creative Content Teams**: High-speed fiber internet and display equipment for video editing, post-production, thumbnail design, rendering, and digital creative work. (Note: The facility is not soundproof for live audio/video recording, but is purpose-built for editing and creative desk work).

## Key Infrastructure & Facilities
- **100% UPS Power Backup**: Zero dropouts during electricity outages or grid fluctuations.
- **High-Speed Fiber Broadband**: Fast and reliable fiber optic connection for cloud development, large uploads, and video editing workflows.
- **Air Conditioned Workspaces**: Climate-controlled comfortable working atmosphere.
- **Modern False Ceilings**: Clean white false ceilings fitted with rectangular LED light panels throughout all workspaces.
- **Meeting Room & Video Editing Suite**: 4K presentation display screen for video review, tech consulting, and client meetings.
- **Indoor Coffee & Outdoor Terrace**: Indoor coffee machines for fresh brews, with peaceful outdoor seating under an extendable temporary awning roof overlooking green coconut groves.
- **Ample Parking**: Dedicated secure parking for automobiles and motorbikes.
- **Serene Surroundings**: Set amidst peaceful green countryside in Pathanamthitta District.

## Indicative Pricing & Lease Terms
- **Long-Term Contract (1–3+ Years)**: ₹40 / sq.ft / month base rate for building & furniture lease.
- **Short-Term Contract (< 1 Year)**: ₹50 / sq.ft / month base rate for building & furniture lease.
- **Fully Managed Package**: Additional +₹20 / sq.ft / month (covers 100% UPS power backup, high-speed fiber internet, AC climate control, indoor coffee machines, maintenance, and parking).
- **Total Fully Managed Rates**: ₹60 / sq.ft / month (Long-Term) | ₹70 / sq.ft / month (Short-Term).
- **Desk Bays**: Indicative starting rate of ~₹4,000 / desk / month.
- **Negotiation Policy**: All prices are indicative estimates and open to custom negotiations based on team size, space requirements, and lease duration.

## Location & Directions
- Positioned on the main corridor connecting Adoor Town and Kottarakkara Town in Pathanamthitta District, near Kollam border.
- Direct phone link for visits and direction guidance: 9972166327.
